entries.title: Fixed Cutout Figure and Three Rod Shadow Puppet

entries.title: Fixed Hand Drum and Forward Cable Auger
entries.description: One newly authored complete static hand-drum drain-auger-style exterior. A full rounded deep horizontal drum body narrows continuously into a forward neck, with an independent complete lower pistol grip rooted in that neck. A true thick blind recessed outlet collar surrounds the short emerging capped flexible cable exterior; the assembly is not described as an unoccupied through bore. At the rear a full short coaxial spindle supports one entire offset crank and a separate projecting shaped crank grip. The large closed drum silhouette, forward narrowed outlet and lower grip are one handheld whole, not the old standing double-flange cable reel with an exposed winding or the open C-frame geared hand drill with a chuck. All numeric geometry newly authored; no old parts imported. Three opaque constant PBR roles, one model zero scenes. Drum interior and hidden mechanism are not modeled. Rigging animation interaction not made.

entries.title: Static Open Window Cabin and Bent Carrier Hanger
entries.description: One wholly newly authored complete aerial-cabin-style static exterior. A single chamfered hollow lower pan has a true empty interior, integral floor and shaped skirt. Eight complete narrow pillars leave open unglazed window bays below a full closed faceted roof; two fixed internal low benches remain inside the pan. A whole thick offset bent suspension-hanger appearance roots into the roof and into a complete overhead double-cheek carrier, with two independently axled wheels whose circumferential grooves are real geometry and whose outer retainers are proud. This ground-resting display has no cable, station or external guide. Unlike the old elevated cage within a tall fixed guide tower and forward trough, the cabin carries its own upper bent hanger and travelling-carriage-style exterior; unlike a Ferris-wheel open tub, it has a full roof/window enclosure and no surrounding observation wheel. Every shell, post, hanger and wheel profile newly drawn, no extracted old cabin or wheel. Three opaque constant PBR roles, metres Z-up and complete horizontal bounds-centred ground origin. One whole static transport prop zero scenes. Unglazed windows are intentional open cutaway appearances, not transparent panes. No actual suspension, travel, cable fit, rotation, boarding, human fit, restraint, payload, manufacture, structural or passenger safety capability; rigging animation interaction not made.

entries.title: Fixed Twin Wheel Through Hopper and Spinner Spreader
entries.description: One complete newly authored static hand-push broadcast-spreader exterior. A broad round thick-wall open hopper narrows continuously into an open lower throat above a separate shallow horizontal disc with four thick blunt radial vanes. Two large side wheels and one full axle carry paired upright hopper supports; two rearward rising push arms end in a transverse dark grip. Two rear parking struts join one finite ground bar. The real upper/lower hopper aperture and the visible gap above the separate disc remain empty, with no contents. All profiles and entire support assembly are new, not replacing the old roller-seeder drum with two wheels or adding a hopper to an old reel mower: no transverse cutting reel, planting tube, roller drum, soil opener or working transmission. One model zero scenes. Fixed stylised parked equipment exterior only; no spreading, seed/fertilizer delivery, coverage, flow, gearing, wheel motion, balance, load, ergonomics, manufacture or safety claim. Rig animation interaction not made.

entries.title: Static Curved Rostrum and Pear Elytra Weevil
entries.description: One newly authored whole stylised weevil-like insect. A high pear-shaped rear body and two thick domed wing covers with a real centre seam narrow forward through a short thorax and small head into one long downcurving stout rostrum continuous with the body. Two complete elbowed club-tip antennae root on the sides of the rostrum rather than on the forehead; six whole angular walking legs have finite grounded toes and small lateral eyes complete the animal. All body stations, curved muzzle, shell sections and limb paths are new, not a rod nose attached to the old low beetle or an ant with its waist filled. One static whole model, zero scenes. Coarse exterior art only, no exact species, scale, internal anatomy, feeding, pest status, gait, flight, biological function, rig, animation or interaction claim.
